name: Webuilders Import Export
author: webuilders

sections.description:
Webuilders Import Export allows you to import and export WordPress content such as posts, pages, custom post types, users, and more using CSV, XML, or other supported formats. It provides field-level mapping for precise data control.

Key Features

  • Granular Selection: Choose exactly which post types, users, or comments you want to export.
  • Meta Field Control: Select individual meta fields for posts, users, and comments.
  • Intuitive Admin Interface: A modern, clean dashboard designed for ease of use.
  • JSON & XML Support: Export and import your data in the format that works best for you.
  • Fast & Lightweight: Optimized to handle large amounts of data without slowing down your site.

Usage

  1. Go to the ‘Webuilders Import Export’ menu.
  2. Select Action: Click Export or Import based on your needs.
  3. Choose Data: Select the specific post types, users, taxonomies, or meta fields.
  4. Download / Upload: Download your tailored export file or upload a file for import.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the webuilders-import-export folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Webuilders Import Export’ menu in your admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does it support custom post types?

Yes, all registered custom post types and custom fields are supported for both importing and exporting.

What formats are supported?

Currently, JSON and XML formats are highly supported, with CSV mapping available for structured data.
